features.note: Unmistakably a 1U 19in rack chassis: flat 43 mm body, 445 mm wide, 559 mm deep, with silver EIA-310 mounting ears on both ends (482.6 mm span). The near-horizontal el 3 hero is correct for a subject whose featureless top is 13x the front face — front reads 43% of the frame, top 33%, side 24% (the P2 analytic prediction held EXACTLY against the built bbox).

Nine module positions built (9 cavities / 9 faces / 9 LEDs / 9 blank plates), recessed 2.5 mm behind the panel via a declared Z-stack. Confirmed by the toggle: MÓDULOS 9/9 vs 6/9 changes the count (faces + blanks always sum 9), so the nine positions are real and distinct. At the blockout exposure on a thin 1U front they read as faint vertical divisions; the clear read strengthens in materials/lighting (see defects).

Three PSU bays with per-PSU LEDs built. The PSU toggle changes the lamp MATERIAL (led_blue standby <-> led_green enabled), both asserted non-black (emissiveIntensity alone is a vacuous assertion — the Axis lesson applied). Present as structure; the lit read needs materials/lighting.

The NMC RJ45 (cage + 8.7 mm throat) and the alarm dry-contact block are built; the alarm block reads as a dark protrusion on the left of the front face (a pluggable connector protrudes by design, within a declared 5 mm allowance). Subtle at blockout exposure.

Livery patch reads on the upper front (white placeholder block; surface pass adds the text). The critical bakes in the no-ratings discipline — verified: no part name carries a rating and the spec text has zero electrical values. The PROCEDENCIA HUD surfaces the honest provenance (distributor dimensions; front layout a declared inference).

important_features.note: Deep 559 mm body reads (13x the height) — the side carries the depth at el 3.
1U ear span and proportion read as rack-mountable.

defects: FRONT FURNITURE READS SUBTLY at the blockout exposure: a 1U front is an inherently thin band and at the near-horizontal el 3 hero (+ dark blockout materials) the 9 slots / 3 PSU / RJ45 / alarm read as faint divisions rather than crisp features. They are all BUILT and verified headless (traceable counts, toggle-confirmed), so this is the normal blockout->materials progression, not missing geometry — but materials and lighting (front-facing, like the UPS) MUST make them legible, and I could not fully count them by eye at this stage.
Front layout is a declared confidence:low inference (elements sourced, arrangement not) — an open item for a product photo, correctly flagged in the HUD.
NO display (sourced absence: NMC web + SNMP) — correctly not built.
corrections: Materials/lighting: make the 9 slots, 3 PSU bays (with lit LEDs), RJ45 and alarm read clearly on the front band; the FMPS lighting rig will need to favour the front like the UPS/Axis (features face forward, top is 13x and featureless).
Surface: livery text under discipline (no ratings).

mechanical.notes: 6/6 suites (trace, struct, framing, light, boot, float). 55 meshes / 1544 tris. Console clean across 4 states. Envelope 482.6/445 x 43 x 559 exact. FIVE defects, two more lesson than fix: (1) the layout consumed the body width to 0.0 mm (445 - 8 margins - 437 furniture = 0, which lands slightly NEGATIVE in binary), so the fit guard fired on a '0.0 mm overflow' — a layout that closes to the mm is tolerance-less; edge margin 4.0 -> 2.5 and the guard now requires 2 mm real slack, not a non-negative result ('did not overflow' was never the property to assert — the positivity lesson). (2) bays were recessed 1 mm not 2.5 because faces were positioned by CENTER (a 3 mm plate centred on the recess sits 1 mm behind the panel — bay vs bevel); fixed with a declared Z-stack (panel/cage/face/led/blank/cavity/throat) + atFront(front, depth) so layers position by where their FRONT falls and can't share a plane silently — which also resolved (3) seventeen coincident front faces by construction. (4) the alarm connector read out-of-bounds; the guard now declares a FRONT_PROTRUSION_ALLOWANCE of 5 mm said aloud (a pluggable connector protrudes by design; past 5 mm is a defect), rear-Z and Y stay absolute. (5) the framing criterion required EVERY view keep >=15% side for depth and suspended front-detail at 10% — but depth is the HERO's job; a detail view asserts the opposite (front >=55%). Verified: all published counts built and traceable, toggles drive both halves (faces+blanks=9, LEDs=modules; PSU material swap non-black both states), framing hero 43/33/24 + detail front 62%, lighting front 2.187 vs top 0.748 (2.92 for a 13x top), 0 floating in both module states, boot clean, no part name carries a rating.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. A clean blockout that reused the UPS scaffolding and applied the run's accumulated lessons PREVENTIVELY — the P2 camera prediction (az 26 / el 3 -> 43% front) held exactly against the built bbox, saving a failed attempt, and the five defects were fixed at the criterion level (a tolerance-less layout, a centre-vs-front recess measure, a said-aloud protrusion allowance, and a third framing-criterion correction giving the depth requirement to the hero alone). All five criticals are built and verified; the one honest caveat is that a thin 1U front reads subtly at blockout exposure, so materials and lighting must make the front furniture legible (I could not fully count it by eye yet). Cleared to the structural pass.
